currentExecutionQueue.summary: Make the long-horizon P0-P9 skeleton machine-readable, mandatory in task context and protected against silent removal or renumbering.

Captured .artifacts/pluggable-stack/baseline.json for Fovea HEAD 7768ed083eee9c54ad86b7124a96f73a202d4c65 (dirty) and clean ImageCraft HEAD 05ab068c851d32a028f8556b2085a3266f0ee78c; content digest 94fa7a76dee3063c5757931143629d83f028e06f04bdd330b1945ec830330179.

The retained composition model and a seven-phase ImageIO lifetime ledger now pass. The ledger identifies prepared-state accumulation, framework-private allocations, output ownership transfer, alias composition and cancellation reclaim tails; held-out backend and real-device evidence remain open.

ImageCraft e147b349d4ff440af6f257c3fb8a7cb4788c953b and Akashic 2715f23d50b5a17b7328be41608eaf1b1c99b0d6 are the only supported component revisions. Both are public, MIT licensed, xcode-27 CI-green and protected by required core checks; physical-device evidence remains open.
ADR-0014 is Accepted. Typed identity, partition-scoped deduplication, one active writer, new-generation migration and 30 named conformance obligations are frozen; implementation moves to P4.

Akashic 2715f23d50b5a17b7328be41608eaf1b1c99b0d6 is public under MIT, xcode-27 CI-green in run 30790047451, tagged 0.1.0-alpha.5, and protected by a required core check. Fovea public-pin clean-copy passes 478/478 and CacheLab V4 is bound to clean source-control resolution; physical power-loss and stable-device resource qualification remain open.

Extend the passing local process/logical-byte resource envelope to stable physical devices; add controlled ENOSPC, short-write, permission-transition, wrong-owner and long-running kill-at-random/power-loss evidence; then establish immutable release identity and protected CI. Reference-model, directory-overflow, negative-consumer and clean-copy gates are complete.

Fovea consumes public Akashic 2715f23d50b5a17b7328be41608eaf1b1c99b0d6 (0.1.0-alpha.5) by exact revision and passes 478/478. Current manifest, resource V2 and fault V5 evidence are bound to this source identity; physical qualification remains open.

Retain the 64 x 4 KiB small-object workload that exposes about 3.8033x application-layer logical write amplification from full-manifest replacement. Compare batching, segmented manifests and append/checkpoint candidates only behind the existing crash, recovery, schema and partition gates.

The privacy-sanitized Fovea publication tree excludes embedded component sources, build artifacts, local paths, credentials and old Git history. Current exact-pin clean-copy passes; public-root CI remains pending.

Fovea consumes ImageCraft e147b349d4ff440af6f257c3fb8a7cb4788c953b as the only supported exact revision, with no embedded production source. Current clean-copy integration passes; physical-device evidence remains open.

Persistent-store provider and ImageCodec v1 remain the sole current conformance kits and pass their independent self-host consumers. Source identity v2 binds component domain, complete coverage, exact exclusions, every file digest and executable bit. The schema-4 Fovea gate independently validates external identity documents, materializes byte-validated snapshots, and executes candidate manifests, package edit, dependency inspection and 478/478 tests inside FOVEA-COMPONENT-CANDIDATE-SANDBOX-V1. Seven runtime probes prove network denial, host-source read denial, host-write denial, isolated Fovea source write denial and both candidate snapshot write denials while the dedicated State root remains writable; immutable Fovea and component identities remain unchanged after testing. Akashic 5887e2facb07 (84 files) and ImageCraft 045aa7013b19 (94 files) also pass full local release-readiness and clean-copy campaigns. The same candidate bytes are now published as Akashic 2715f23d50b5 / 0.1.0-alpha.5 and ImageCraft e147b349d4ff / 0.1.0-alpha.4, with both component GitHub Verify workflows green and Fovea pinned to those exact revisions. The sandbox still uses deprecated SwiftPM native build system and candidates can read the isolated Fovea source graph, so default swiftbuild equivalence, mutual confidentiality, Fovea protected CI, real independent third-party implementations and physical-device qualification remain pending.

Every production and package-level codec composition requires ImageCodec. FoveaAdvancedSystem accepts only an immutable qualified persistent-store bundle binding provider identity, generation fingerprint, encoded/record/namespace persistence and lifetime. No legacy decoder path remains.
Run the V8-prepared W7 matrix plus W1/W2/W3/W8/W10/W13 from clean exact-pin source; quiet-host formal and physical evidence remain required.
Xcode 27/Swift 6.4 selection and local gates pass. Current ImageCraft and Akashic revisions are green on xcode-27; the sanitized private Fovea root remains the hosted-CI task.
ImageCraft passes 64 tests, release, compatibility and macOS 12/iOS 15 platform builds under Swift 6.4. RawSpan hot parsing and public noncopyable preparation remain evidence-blocked.
Akashic noncopyable writer lease and defer cleanup pass 41 tests, release, consumers, API baseline and six macOS 12/iOS 15 platform cases.

Fovea with the current Swift 6.4 ImageCraft/Akashic revisions passes local composition tests. Seven macOS adapters, seven iOS adapters and Apple/Fovea SwiftUI surfaces build under the locked comparative contract. No performance or Phase 1 claim is permitted; protected clean-copy CI remains open.

PipelineCache was split from one 945-line production file into a 233-line coordination base, 287-line transport-handoff extension, 125-line rendered-cache extension and 328-line persistence extension. The FoveaCore cohesion review was rebound to the 57-file set without weakening the 500-line file gate or creating a dependency cycle; the structural-quality gate passes.

Added CH-TRANSPORT-BUFFER-ISOLATION-024 from the locked Kingfisher native buffer-side-effect test mechanism. Fovea now proves that caller mutation cannot alter a finalized verified response body and that append/finalize after finalization fail closed. The challenge is mapped to W6; native upstream failures remain independent evidence and no ranking claim follows.

Closed a transport-verified handoff purge race exposed by the full parallel suite. Purge and namespace cleanup now advance a publication epoch, remove only indexed bodies, and leave the shared root intact until store destruction; directory security preparation is serialized without serializing payload copies. In-flight preparations admitted before purge cannot publish afterward, filesystem failures caused by a superseding cleanup normalize to cancellation, and concurrent insertion tests no longer suppress errors. The 478-test suite passed twice consecutively in full parallel mode.

The locked comparative lab completed all seven configured adapter validations with external sources enabled and iOS builds enabled. Apple URLSession/URLCache/ImageIO, Fovea, Nuke, Kingfisher, SDWebImage, AlamofireImage and PINRemoteImage passed macOS and generic iOS Simulator builds; the native URLCache behavior contract and 11 simulator-support tests also passed. This establishes source-pin and adapter compatibility only. Phase 1 declaration and performance ranking remain blocked by the dirty Fovea workspace identity, stable runtime/device evidence, repeated measurements and the other preregistered entry blockers.

Raised the engineering target from at-least-one practically superior endpoint to endpoint-by-endpoint dominance. Every applicable L2 primary endpoint must beat every eligible comparator by a preregistered substantial margin (default 20%) or prove a machine-checkable optimal floor; at least 80% of applicable L3 endpoints must be substantially superior and none may be materially inferior. Aggregate scores and post-result comparator removal remain forbidden.

The released NSLock SIEVE baseline remains authoritative. Four speculative directions were rejected by paired evidence: os_unfair_lock improved throughput but materially regressed p99; pthread rwlock improved p99 but collapsed throughput; generic optional slots regressed both; sharded reads either regressed writer tails or, with a writer gate, regressed all primary endpoints. A direct pthread mutex did not clear confidence-bound dominance. The next optimization must reduce exact SIEVE critical-section work without changing iOS 15 support or endpoint semantics.

Akashic disk publication now uses schema-compatible incremental manifest records, bounded generation checkpoints, fd-based temporary inode hardening and a same-directory two-file fast commit. Migration/replay/tombstone/corrupt-record/stale-generation tests, 11 deterministic process-exit points, 78 random-kill cases and the six-case Apple platform matrix pass. A 20-run same-D5 CacheLab block put write throughput, read throughput and read p99 above the preregistered 20% dominance margin versus the durable-validated PIN wrapper. The worktree is dirty and Akashic release/API/fault evidence must be rebound before a release claim.

V4 executes twenty fresh-cache rounds and uses eight shards after sixteen and thirty-two shards failed explicit retention counterexamples. Twenty clean process blocks pass all thirteen applicable endpoint-dominance comparisons. The 81-file Git-free Akashic candidate 91608c55745b333bf28b923bf0bf64744541b5e81344f061a251adea483bdb92 passes 55 tests, clean-copy replay, fault/quota/resource/concurrency mechanics, six Apple Release builds and an independent Fovea 478/478 integration. A public Akashic revision, exact Fovea pin and clean trusted CI remain mandatory.

Cache Lab V4 binds twenty fresh-cache hot rounds, 1536 post-throughput disk p99 samples, eight shards, independent process blocks and contamination rejection. The local twenty-block campaign passes all thirteen applicable comparisons with zero correctness, inferior, inconclusive or dominance failures. The result remains local research evidence until the measured Akashic candidate is published, Fovea pins that exact revision and protected trusted CI repeats from clean checkouts.

routeInvariants: Every multi-step Fovea task loads this manifest through the mandatory project context before changes.
P0 through P9 retain only current active or completed obligations; superseded implementation paths are deleted after durable decisions are normalized.
Planned, specified, implemented, calibrated, formally verified and release-eligible remain distinct states.
Dirty source may support local diagnosis and planning but cannot support trusted release evidence.
ImageCraft and Akashic are consumed only through current exact public revisions and isolated source identities.
Fovea retains HTTP, authorization, identity, namespace revocation, shared-work and cross-store commit state machines.
A second production codec cannot be admitted until resource-estimate coverage and codec conformance obligations are explicit.
New research changes the route only through a recorded adoption, rejection or supersession decision.
